```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/apps/shared/abcjs-audio.css">

<style>
#songs-root {
  --pr:#2780e3; --br:#dee2e6; --bl:#e9ecef; --mu:#6c757d;
  --in:#212529; --sf:#fff; --bs:#f8f9fa; --cue:#b7005a;
  max-width:1240px; margin:0 auto 2rem;
  font-family:var(--bs-font-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif); color:var(--in);
}
#songs-root .sq-card {
  background:var(--sf); border:1px solid var(--br); border-radius:.5rem;
  padding:1rem 1.15rem; margin:0 0 1rem; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.04);
}
#songs-root .sq-row { display:flex; gap:.5rem .75rem; align-items:flex-end; flex-wrap:wrap; }
#songs-root .sq-group { display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
#songs-root .sq-label {
  font-size:.78rem; color:var(--mu); font-weight:600;
  text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.03em; margin-bottom:.25rem;
}
#songs-root h2 {
  font-size:.78rem; color:var(--mu); font-weight:700;
  text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em; margin:0 0 .75rem;
}
#songs-root select, #songs-root input[type=number], #songs-root .sq-multi > summary {
  padding:.35rem .6rem; font-size:.9rem; border:1px solid #ced4da;
  border-radius:.375rem; background:var(--sf); color:var(--in); height:auto;
}
#songs-root input[type=number] { width:5rem; }
/* Result stays pinned under the site navbar / session bar while the banks scroll;
   --nav-h and --session-h are measured by syncStickyOffset_s(). */
#songs-root .sq-sticky {
  position:sticky; top:max(var(--nav-h,56px), var(--session-h,0px)); z-index:10;
  transition:top .2s; box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
}
body:has(#quarto-header.headroom--unpinned) #songs-root .sq-sticky { top:var(--session-h,0px); }
#songs-root #full-paper { max-height:min(40vh,320px); overflow-y:auto; }
#songs-root .sq-cols {
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,2fr) minmax(0,3fr); gap:1rem; align-items:start;
}
#songs-root .sq-cols .sq-card { margin:0; }
@media (max-width:760px) { #songs-root .sq-cols { grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr); } #songs-root #full-paper { max-height:min(22vh,190px); } }
#songs-root .chord-palette { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:4px; }
#songs-root .chord-position { font-size:.82rem; color:var(--mu); margin-bottom:.45rem; white-space:nowrap; }
#songs-root #full-paper .sq-cursor { fill:var(--pr); stroke:var(--pr); }
#songs-root #full-paper .sq-playing { fill:var(--cue); stroke:var(--cue); }
#songs-root .sq-settings .sq-multi-panel { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.5rem .75rem; align-items:flex-end; max-height:none; right:0; left:auto; }
#songs-root .sq-settings .sq-check { flex-basis:100%; margin:0; }
#songs-root .cell-tabs { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:4px; margin-bottom:.5rem; }
#songs-root.all-patterns #tonal-collection-picker { opacity:.5; pointer-events:none; }
#songs-root:not(.by-chord) #include-stepwise-label { display:none; }
#songs-root .cell-tabs .sq-label { align-self:center; margin:0 .25rem 0 0; min-width:3.2rem; }
#songs-root .cell-tabs .sq-btn.active { border-color:var(--pr); color:var(--pr); font-weight:600; }
#songs-root .sq-paper.is-empty { display:none; }
#title-block-header { display:none; }
#songs-root .cell-btn.cell-dim { opacity:.3; }
#songs-root .sq-check {
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; font-size:.9rem; margin:0 0 .4rem;
}
#songs-root .sq-check input { width:auto; margin:0; }
#songs-root .sq-multi { position:relative; margin-bottom:0; }
#songs-root .sq-multi > summary {
  list-style:none; cursor:pointer; max-width:16rem;
  white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis;
}
#songs-root .sq-multi > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; }
#songs-root .sq-multi > summary::after { content:" \25BE"; color:var(--mu); }
#songs-root .sq-multi-panel {
  position:absolute; z-index:5; top:calc(100% + 4px); left:0;
  width:min(22rem,80vw); max-height:300px; overflow-y:auto;
  background:var(--sf); border:1px solid var(--br); border-radius:.375rem;
  box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.12); padding:.5rem .7rem;
}
#songs-root .sq-multi-hint { margin:0; font-size:.8rem; color:var(--mu); }
#songs-root .sq-multi-heading {
  font-size:.72rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--mu);
  text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.04em; margin:.5rem 0 .15rem;
}
#songs-root .sq-multi-group { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:1px 10px; }
#songs-root .sq-multi-group label {
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:.88rem; font-weight:normal;
}
#songs-root .sq-multi-group input { width:auto; margin:0; }
#songs-root .sq-btn {
  padding:.35rem .7rem; font-size:.9rem; border:1px solid #ced4da;
  border-radius:.375rem; background:var(--sf); color:var(--in);
  cursor:pointer; line-height:1.5; white-space:nowrap;
}
#songs-root .sq-btn:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }
#songs-root .sq-paper {
  background:var(--sf); border:1px solid var(--bl); border-radius:.375rem;
  padding:.4rem .5rem; min-height:56px; margin-bottom:.5rem;
}
#songs-root .sq-paper svg { width:100% !important; height:auto !important; display:block; }
#songs-root textarea {
  display:none; box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; min-height:70px;
  padding:.4rem .5rem; font-family:monospace; font-size:.82rem;
  border:1px solid var(--br); border-radius:.375rem;
  background:var(--bs); color:var(--in); resize:vertical; margin-bottom:.5rem;
}
#songs-root textarea[readonly] { background:#f0f0f0; color:var(--mu); }
#songs-root.show-abc textarea { display:block; }
#songs-root .cue-note {
  min-height:1.3em; color:var(--cue); font-style:italic;
  font-size:.88rem; margin-bottom:.5rem;
}
#songs-root .expansion-picker {
  display:none; border:1px solid #9ec5fe; background:#e7f1ff;
  border-radius:.375rem; padding:.75rem 1rem; margin-bottom:.75rem;
}
#songs-root .expansion-picker.visible { display:block; }
#songs-root .expansion-picker p { margin:0 0 .5rem; font-size:.88rem; }
#songs-root .expansion-options { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; margin-top:.5rem; }
#songs-root .expansion-option {
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:4px;
}
#songs-root .expansion-key { font-weight:700; font-size:.82rem; color:var(--mu); }
#songs-root .cell-criteria {
  display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:4px 14px; margin-bottom:.6rem; font-size:.9rem;
}
#songs-root .cell-criteria label {
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; font-weight:normal; color:var(--in);
}
#songs-root .cell-criteria input[type=checkbox] { width:auto; margin:0; }
#songs-root .cell-bank { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:flex-end; gap:6px; margin:4px 0 .75rem; }
#songs-root .cell-buttons { display:contents; }
#songs-root .cell-wrapper { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; }
#songs-root .cell-number { font-size:11px; color:var(--mu); margin-bottom:2px; margin-left:4px; }
#songs-root .cell-btn {
  background:var(--sf) !important; border:1px solid #ced4da !important;
  border-radius:.375rem !important; cursor:pointer !important;
  padding:2px !important; box-sizing:content-box !important;
  position:relative; overflow:hidden;
  transition:border-color .12s, box-shadow .12s;
}
#songs-root .cell-btn:hover {
  border-color:var(--pr) !important; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(39,128,227,.15) !important;
}
#songs-root .cell-preview { pointer-events:none; }
#songs-root .cell-preview svg { display:block; }
/* Suppress zero-height staff in rhythm cell buttons only */
#songs-root #rhythm-cell-buttons .abcjs-staff,
#songs-root #cued-rhythm-paper .abcjs-staff { display:none; }
</style>

<script>
	/* ------- Rhythm side: MLT cell system (from rhythm-sequences) ------- */
	const FAMILIES_s = {
		duple: { defaultL: "1/4", microbeatCount: 2, unitsPerMacrobeat: 1 },
		triple: { defaultL: "1/8", microbeatCount: 3, unitsPerMacrobeat: 3 }
	};
	const SOURCE_COLLECTIONS_s = {
		duple: ["Duple-M-m-2-4", "Duple-M-m-D-2/4", "Duple, M-m-D-E-2/4", "Duple, M-m-R-2/4", "Duple, M-m-D-E-R-U-2/4"],
		triple: ["Triple-M-m-6/8", "Triple-M-m-D-6/8", "Triple-M-m-D-E-6/8"]
	};
	/* Enrhythmic notation: same cells, written with a different unit note length. */
	const ENRHYTHMIC_L_s = { triple: { "3/4": "1/4" } };
	const cellPoolCache_s = {};

	function getActiveFamily_s() {
		return document.getElementById("rhythm-family-selector").value;
	}

	function unitLength_s(family, timeSignature) {
		const enrhythmic = ENRHYTHMIC_L_s[family];
		return (enrhythmic && enrhythmic[timeSignature]) || FAMILIES_s[family].defaultL;
	}

	function inferCriteriaFromCollectionName_s(name) {
		const tokens = name.split(/[-,]/).map(function(t) { return t.trim(); });
		return {
			macrobeat: true, microbeat: true,
			division: tokens.indexOf("D") !== -1,
			elongation: tokens.indexOf("E") !== -1,
			rest: tokens.indexOf("R") !== -1
		};
	}

	function getSelectedCriteria_s() {
		return {
			macrobeat: document.getElementById("crit-macrobeat").checked,
			microbeat: document.getElementById("crit-microbeat").checked,
			division: document.getElementById("crit-division").checked,
			elongation: document.getElementById("crit-elongation").checked,
			rest: document.getElementById("crit-rest").checked
		};
	}

	function tokenLenFraction_s(mod) {
		if (!mod) return [1, 1];
		const match = /^(\d*)(\/*)(\d*)$/.exec(mod);
		const numerator = match[1] ? parseInt(match[1], 10) : 1;
		let denominator;
		if (match[2]) denominator = match[3] ? parseInt(match[3], 10) : Math.pow(2, match[2].length);
		else denominator = 1;
		return [numerator, denominator];
	}

	function parseGroupTokens_s(group) {
		const tokens = [];
		let i = 0;
		let pendingMultiplier = 1;
		let hasRest = false;
		let hasElongationMark = false;
		while (i < group.length) {
			const ch = group[i];
			if (ch === "B" || ch === "z") {
				if (ch === "z") hasRest = true;
				let j = i + 1;
				let mod = "";
				while (j < group.length && /[\d/]/.test(group[j])) { mod += group[j]; j++; }
				let tie = false;
				if (group[j] === "-") { tie = true; j++; }
				const lenFraction = tokenLenFraction_s(mod);
				let duration = (lenFraction[0] / lenFraction[1]) * pendingMultiplier;
				pendingMultiplier = 1;
				if (group[j] === ">") { duration *= 1.5; pendingMultiplier = 0.5; hasElongationMark = true; j++; }
				else if (group[j] === "<") { duration *= 0.5; pendingMultiplier = 1.5; hasElongationMark = true; j++; }
				tokens.push({ duration: duration, tie: tie });
				i = j;
			} else { i++; }
		}
		return { tokens: tokens, hasRest: hasRest, hasElongationMark: hasElongationMark };
	}

	const FORCE_DIV_ELO_s = new Set(["B/>B/", "B/<B/", "B//B/B//"]);

	function classifyCell_s(group, family) {
		const familyInfo = FAMILIES_s[family];
		const parsed = parseGroupTokens_s(group);
		if (parsed.tokens.length === 0) return null;
		if (parsed.tokens[parsed.tokens.length - 1].tie) return null;
		const total = parsed.tokens.reduce(function(sum, t) { return sum + t.duration; }, 0);
		if (Math.abs(total - familyInfo.unitsPerMacrobeat) > 1e-9) return null;
		const microbeatDuration = familyInfo.unitsPerMacrobeat / familyInfo.microbeatCount;
		const hasDivision = parsed.tokens.some(function(t) { return t.duration < microbeatDuration - 1e-9; });
		const isMacrobeat = parsed.tokens.length === 1 && !parsed.hasRest && !parsed.hasElongationMark;
		const isMicrobeat = !isMacrobeat && !parsed.hasRest && !parsed.hasElongationMark && !hasDivision &&
			parsed.tokens.length === familyInfo.microbeatCount &&
			parsed.tokens.every(function(t) { return Math.abs(t.duration - microbeatDuration) < 1e-9; });
		const required = {};
		if (isMacrobeat) required.macrobeat = true;
		else if (isMicrobeat) required.microbeat = true;
		else {
			if (hasDivision) required.division = true;
			if (parsed.hasElongationMark) required.elongation = true;
			if (parsed.hasRest) required.rest = true;
		}
		if (FORCE_DIV_ELO_s.has(group)) return { required: { division: true, elongation: true } };
		return { required: required };
	}

	function extractCellsFromCollection_s(collectionKey, family) {
		const tuneBook = new ABCJS.TuneBook(rhythmPatternObject[collectionKey]);
		const found = [];
		tuneBook.tunes.forEach(function(tune) {
			const lines = tune.abc.split("\n");
			let bodyLine = "";
			lines.forEach(function(line) {
				if (/^[A-Za-z]:/.test(line)) return;
				if (line.trim() === "") return;
				bodyLine = line;
			});
			if (!bodyLine) return;
			bodyLine.split("|").forEach(function(bar) {
				bar.trim().split(/\s+/).forEach(function(group) {
					if (group === "") return;
					const classified = classifyCell_s(group, family);
					if (classified) found.push({ abc: group, required: classified.required });
				});
			});
		});
		return found;
	}

	const LONG_ELO_CELLS_s = {
		duple: [
			{ abc: "B2", required: { elongation: true } },
			{ abc: "B3 B", required: { elongation: true } },
			{ abc: "B B3", required: { elongation: true } },
			{ abc: "B4", required: { elongation: true } },
			{ abc: "B> B", required: { elongation: true } },
			{ abc: "B< B", required: { elongation: true } },
			{ abc: "B/ B B/", required: { elongation: true } },
			{ abc: "B//B/B/B/B//", required: { division: true, elongation: true } }
		],
		triple: [
			{ abc: "B B2", required: { elongation: true } },
			{ abc: "B2 B", required: { elongation: true } },
			{ abc: "B6", required: { elongation: true } }
		]
	};

	function getLongEloCells_s(family) {
		return LONG_ELO_CELLS_s[family].map(function(entry) {
			const parsed = parseGroupTokens_s(entry.abc);
			const totalLUnits = parsed.tokens.reduce(function(sum, t) { return sum + t.duration; }, 0);
			return { abc: entry.abc, required: entry.required, totalLUnits: totalLUnits };
		});
	}

	function getCellPool_s(family) {
		if (cellPoolCache_s[family]) return cellPoolCache_s[family];
		const seen = new Set();
		const pool = [];
		SOURCE_COLLECTIONS_s[family].forEach(function(collectionKey) {
			extractCellsFromCollection_s(collectionKey, family).forEach(function(cell) {
				if (seen.has(cell.abc)) return;
				seen.add(cell.abc);
				pool.push(cell);
			});
		});
		getLongEloCells_s(family).forEach(function(cell) {
			if (seen.has(cell.abc)) return;
			seen.add(cell.abc);
			pool.push(cell);
		});
		cellPoolCache_s[family] = pool;
		return pool;
	}

	function parseFraction_s(str, fallback) {
		const match = (str || "").match(/(\d+)\s*\/\s*(\d+)/);
		return match ? parseInt(match[1]) / parseInt(match[2]) : fallback;
	}

	function getMeterInfo_s() {
		const family = getActiveFamily_s();
		const familyInfo = FAMILIES_s[family];
		const timeSignature = document.getElementById("time-signature-selector").value;
		const unitL = unitLength_s(family, timeSignature);
		const Lfraction = parseFraction_s(unitL, 0.25);
		const barCapacity = parseFraction_s(timeSignature, 1) * 4;
		return { Lfraction: Lfraction, barCapacity: barCapacity, timeSignature: timeSignature, familyInfo: familyInfo, unitL: unitL,
			beatQuarters: familyInfo.unitsPerMacrobeat * Lfraction * 4 };
	}

	function getTempo_s() {
		const input = document.getElementById("tempo-input");
		const bpm = parseInt(input.value, 10);
		if (isNaN(bpm)) return parseInt(input.defaultValue, 10);
		return Math.min(Math.max(bpm, parseInt(input.min, 10)), parseInt(input.max, 10));
	}

	function tempoChanged_s() {
		document.getElementById("tempo-input").value = getTempo_s();
		renderFullNotation_s();
	}

	/* Tempo counts macrobeats, so enrhythmic time signatures sound alike. */
	function tempoField_s(meter) {
		return meter.familyInfo.unitsPerMacrobeat + "/" + meter.unitL.split("/")[1] + "=" + getTempo_s();
	}

	function getFilteredCells_s(family, criteria) {
		const meter = getMeterInfo_s();
		return getCellPool_s(family).filter(function(cell) {
			if (!Object.keys(cell.required).every(function(need) { return criteria[need]; })) return false;
			if (cell.totalLUnits !== undefined && cell.totalLUnits * meter.Lfraction * 4 > meter.barCapacity + 1e-9) return false;
			return true;
		});
	}

	function tokenizeRhythmCell_s(cell) {
		const segments = [];
		let i = 0;
		let pendingMultiplier = 1;
		while (i < cell.length) {
			const ch = cell[i];
			if (ch === "B" || ch === "z") {
				let j = i + 1;
				let suffix = "";
				while (j < cell.length && /[\d/]/.test(cell[j])) { suffix += cell[j]; j++; }
				let tie = "";
				if (cell[j] === "-") { tie = "-"; j++; }
				const lenFraction = tokenLenFraction_s(suffix);
				let duration = (lenFraction[0] / lenFraction[1]) * pendingMultiplier;
				pendingMultiplier = 1;
				let dotMark = "";
				if (cell[j] === ">") { duration *= 1.5; pendingMultiplier = 0.5; dotMark = ">"; j++; }
				else if (cell[j] === "<") { duration *= 0.5; pendingMultiplier = 1.5; dotMark = "<"; j++; }
				segments.push({ type: ch === "B" ? "note" : "rest", suffix: suffix, tie: tie, dotMark: dotMark, duration: duration });
				i = j;
			} else { i++; }
		}
		return segments;
	}

	function hitCount_s(cell) {
		return tokenizeRhythmCell_s(cell).filter(function(s) { return s.type === "note"; }).length;
	}

	function cellQuarters_s(cellAbc, Lfraction) {
		return tokenizeRhythmCell_s(cellAbc).reduce(function(sum, seg) { return sum + seg.duration * Lfraction * 4; }, 0);
	}

	function lUnitsToSuffix_s(lUnits) {
		const rounded = Math.round(lUnits);
		return rounded === 1 ? "" : String(rounded);
	}

	function resolvedPhrases_s() {
		const open = currentOpenPhrase_s();
		return phrases_s.filter(function(p) { return p !== open; });
	}

	function pickupOffsetQuarters_s(Lfraction, barCapacity) {
		const total = resolvedPhrases_s().reduce(function(sum, p) {
			return sum + p.rhythmCells.reduce(function(s, rc) { return s + cellQuarters_s(rc.abc, Lfraction); }, 0);
		}, 0);
		return total % barCapacity;
	}

	function phraseRhythmQuartersSoFar_s(phrase, Lfraction) {
		return phrase.rhythmCells.reduce(function(sum, rc) { return sum + cellQuarters_s(rc.abc, Lfraction); }, 0);
	}

	function onGrid_s(quarters, step) {
		const ratio = quarters / step;
		return Math.abs(ratio - Math.round(ratio)) < 1e-9;
	}

	function fractionSuffix_s(lUnits) {
		for (let den = 1; den <= 16; den *= 2) {
			const num = Math.round(lUnits * den);
			if (Math.abs(num - lUnits * den) > 1e-9) continue;
			if (den === 1) return num === 1 ? "" : String(num);
			return (num === 1 ? "" : num) + "/" + den;
		}
		return String(lUnits);
	}

	/* ------- Rhythm spelling ------- */
	/* Chords are keyed by position in macrobeats; a chord over a note inside a beat has a fractional key. */
	function chordKey_s(beats) { return Math.round(beats * 96) / 96; }

	/* Grid sizes in quarters, coarsest first: bar, half bar (four-beat bars), macrobeat,
	   microbeat, then halves of the microbeat. */
	function metricGrid_s(meter) {
		const beats = Math.round(meter.barCapacity / meter.beatQuarters);
		const levels = [meter.barCapacity];
		if (beats === 4) levels.push(meter.beatQuarters * 2);
		if (beats > 1) levels.push(meter.beatQuarters);
		let size = meter.beatQuarters / meter.familyInfo.microbeatCount;
		for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++, size /= 2) levels.push(size);
		return { levels: levels, bar: meter.barCapacity, beat: meter.beatQuarters, beats: beats,
			micro: meter.beatQuarters / meter.familyInfo.microbeatCount, compound: meter.familyInfo.microbeatCount === 3 };
	}

	function isPlainValue_s(quarters) {
		for (let value = 4; value > 1 / 32; value /= 2) if (Math.abs(quarters - value) < 1e-9) return true;
		return false;
	}

	/* Can [from, to), measured from the bar line, be written as one note?
	   - it has to be a plain or dotted note value;
	   - anything goes inside a macrobeat;
	   - a note that starts on a macrobeat may run over later ones (in compound meters only
	     if it also ends on one);
	   - a note that starts inside a macrobeat stops at the next one, except the short-long-short
	     syncopation of simple meters, which may not hide the middle of a four-beat bar. */
	function noteFits_s(from, to, grid) {
		const length = to - from;
		if (!isPlainValue_s(length) && !isPlainValue_s(length / 1.5)) return false;
		const nextBeat = (Math.floor(from / grid.beat + 1e-9) + 1) * grid.beat;
		if (to <= nextBeat + 1e-9) return true;
		if (onGrid_s(from, grid.beat)) return !grid.compound || onGrid_s(to, grid.beat);
		if (grid.compound || !isPlainValue_s(length) || length > grid.beat + 1e-9) return false;
		if (Math.abs((nextBeat - from) - length / 2) > 1e-9) return false;
		return !(grid.beats === 4 && onGrid_s(nextBeat, grid.beat * 2));
	}

	/* Can [from, to) be written as one rest? Rests show the metric grid: each is one grid size
	   long and starts on that grid. A silent bar takes a whole-bar rest, and the first two
	   microbeats of a compound macrobeat may share a rest. */
	function restFits_s(from, to, grid) {
		const length = to - from;
		if (grid.compound && Math.abs(length - grid.micro * 2) < 1e-9 && onGrid_s(from, grid.beat)) return true;
		for (let i = 0; i < grid.levels.length; i++) {
			if (Math.abs(length - grid.levels[i]) < 1e-9) return onGrid_s(from, grid.levels[i]);
		}
		return false;
	}

	/* Splits [from, to) at the strongest grid line inside it until every piece can be written. */
	function spellSpan_s(from, to, isRest, grid) {
		if (isRest ? restFits_s(from, to, grid) : noteFits_s(from, to, grid)) return [[from, to]];
		for (let i = 0; i < grid.levels.length; i++) {
			const size = grid.levels[i];
			const first = (Math.floor(from / size + 1e-9) + 1) * size;
			if (first >= to - 1e-9) continue;
			const cut = onGrid_s(from, size) ? (Math.ceil(to / size - 1e-9) - 1) * size : first;
			return spellSpan_s(from, cut, isRest, grid).concat(spellSpan_s(cut, to, isRest, grid));
		}
		return [[from, to]];
	}

	/* Writes rhythm cells (with pitches, or on B without) as ABC words, one per macrobeat so
	   beams follow the beat, with "|" words for bar lines. startQuarters is the absolute
	   position in the song. The cells are respelled as a whole each time: neighbouring rests
	   merge, and notes and rests are split (notes tied) at bar lines, at chord changes
	   (chords: position in macrobeats -> symbol, optional) and wherever spellSpan_s says. */
	function renderBarredWords_s(rhythmCells, pitches, startQuarters, meter, chords) {
		const unit = meter.Lfraction * 4;
		const grid = metricGrid_s(meter);
		const chordTimes = Object.keys(chords || {}).map(function(key) { return Number(key) * grid.beat; });

		const events = [];
		let now = startQuarters, p = 0;
		rhythmCells.forEach(function(rc) {
			tokenizeRhythmCell_s(rc.abc).forEach(function(seg) {
				const end = now + seg.duration * unit;
				const last = events[events.length - 1];
				if (seg.type === "rest" && last && last.rest) last.end = end;
				else if (seg.type === "rest") events.push({ rest: true, start: now, end: end });
				else events.push({ start: now, end: end, pitch: pitches ? pitches[p++] : "B", tie: seg.tie });
				now = end;
			});
		});

		const words = [];
		let wordBuffer = "";
		function flushWord() { if (wordBuffer) { words.push(wordBuffer); wordBuffer = ""; } }

		events.forEach(function(event) {
			let from = event.start;
			while (from < event.end - 1e-9) {
				const barStart = Math.floor(from / grid.bar + 1e-9) * grid.bar;
				let to = Math.min(event.end, barStart + grid.bar);
				chordTimes.forEach(function(time) { if (time > from + 1e-9 && time < to - 1e-9) to = time; });
				spellSpan_s(from - barStart, to - barStart, !!event.rest, grid).forEach(function(span) {
					const start = barStart + span[0], end = barStart + span[1];
					const symbol = chords && chords[chordKey_s(start / grid.beat)];
					/* abcjs draws a whole rest as a centred whole-bar rest in bars up to 4/4 */
					const wholeBar = event.rest && Math.abs(end - start - grid.bar) < 1e-9 && grid.bar <= 4;
					wordBuffer += (symbol ? '"' + symbol + '"' : "") + (event.rest ? "z" : event.pitch) +
						fractionSuffix_s((wholeBar ? 4 : end - start) / unit) +
						(event.rest ? "" : (end < event.end - 1e-9 ? "-" : event.tie));
					if (onGrid_s(end, grid.bar)) { flushWord(); words.push("|"); }
					else if (onGrid_s(end, grid.beat)) flushWord();
				});
				from = to;
			}
		});
		flushWord();
		return words;
	}

	function splitSegmentsAt_s(segments, splitAt) {
		if (splitAt > 0 && splitAt < segments.length && segments[splitAt - 1].dotMark) splitAt += 1;
		const firstSegs = segments.slice(0, splitAt);
		const restSegs = segments.slice(splitAt);
		function toAbc(segs) {
			return segs.map(function(seg) { return (seg.type === "note" ? "B" : "z") + seg.suffix + seg.tie + seg.dotMark; }).join("");
		}
		function toHits(segs) { return segs.filter(function(s) { return s.type === "note"; }).length; }
		return {
			first: firstSegs.length ? { abc: toAbc(firstSegs), hits: toHits(firstSegs) } : null,
			rest: restSegs.length ? { abc: toAbc(restSegs), hits: toHits(restSegs) } : null
		};
	}

	function splitRhythmCellByHits_s(cellAbc, hitsToKeep) {
		const segments = tokenizeRhythmCell_s(cellAbc);
		if (hitsToKeep <= 0) return splitSegmentsAt_s(segments, 0);
		let seen = 0, splitAt = segments.length;
		for (let i = 0; i < segments.length; i++) {
			if (segments[i].type === "note") {
				seen++;
				if (seen === hitsToKeep) { splitAt = i + 1; break; }
			}
		}
		return splitSegmentsAt_s(segments, splitAt);
	}

	function trimRhythmCellsToHits_s(rhythmCells, hitsToKeep) {
		const kept = [];
		const leftover = [];
		let remaining = hitsToKeep;
		rhythmCells.forEach(function(rc) {
			if (remaining <= 0) { leftover.push(rc); return; }
			if (rc.hits <= remaining) { kept.push(rc); remaining -= rc.hits; }
			else {
				const split = splitRhythmCellByHits_s(rc.abc, remaining);
				if (split.first) kept.push(split.first);
				if (split.rest) leftover.push(split.rest);
				remaining = 0;
			}
		});
		return { kept: kept, leftover: leftover };
	}

	function splitTonalCellByNotes_s(cellAbc, notesToKeep) {
		const chordMatch = cellAbc.match(/^"[^"]*"\s*/);
		const chordPrefix = chordMatch ? chordMatch[0] : "";
		const tokens = cellAbc.slice(chordPrefix.length).trim().split(/\s+/).filter(function(t) { return t !== ""; });
		const keep = Math.max(0, notesToKeep);
		const firstTokens = tokens.slice(0, keep);
		const restTokens = tokens.slice(keep);
		function toPitches(toks) { return toks.map(function(t) { return t.replace(/0$/, ""); }); }
		return {
			first: firstTokens.length ? { abc: chordPrefix + firstTokens.join(" "), pitches: toPitches(firstTokens) } : null,
			rest: restTokens.length ? { abc: restTokens.join(" "), pitches: toPitches(restTokens) } : null
		};
	}

	/* ------- Tonal side ------- */
	function indexToLetter_s(i) {
		const letter = String.fromCharCode(65 + (i % 26));
		return i < 26 ? letter : String.fromCharCode(64 + Math.floor(i / 26)) + letter;
	}

	function extractV1Notes_s(tuneAbc, stripChords) {
		let v1Line = "";
		tuneAbc.split("\n").forEach(function(line) {
			if (line.indexOf("[V: V1]") !== -1) v1Line = line;
		});
		v1Line = v1Line.replace("[V: V1]", "").trim();
		if (stripChords) v1Line = v1Line.replace(/"[^"]*"/g, "").trim();
		return v1Line;
	}

	function tokenizePitches_s(tonalAbc) {
		return tonalAbc.replace(/"[^"]*"/g, "").trim().split(/\s+/).filter(function(t) { return t !== ""; })
			.map(function(t) { return t.replace(/0$/, ""); });
	}

	const TONALITY_LABELS_s = { maj: "Major", m: "Minor", dor: "Dorian", phr: "Phrygian", lyd: "Lydian", mix: "Mixolydian", loc: "Locrian" };
	const NOTE_PC_s = { C: 0, D: 2, E: 4, F: 5, G: 7, A: 9, B: 11 };
	const collectionInfoCache_s = {};
	const tonalCellCache_s = {};

	function collectionInfo_s(name) {
		if (collectionInfoCache_s[name]) return collectionInfoCache_s[name];
		const match = /^K:\s*([A-G])([#b]?)\s*([A-Za-z]*)/m.exec(patternObject[name]) || [null, "C", "", ""];
		const suffix = match[3];
		const lower = suffix.toLowerCase();
		const mode = (lower === "" || lower.indexOf("maj") === 0) ? "maj"
			: (lower === "m" || lower.indexOf("min") === 0) ? "m" : lower.slice(0, 3);
		const tonicPc = (NOTE_PC_s[match[1]] + (match[2] === "#" ? 1 : match[2] === "b" ? 11 : 0)) % 12;
		collectionInfoCache_s[name] = { writtenKey: match[1] + match[2] + suffix, key: "C" + suffix, mode: mode, tonicPc: tonicPc };
		return collectionInfoCache_s[name];
	}

	/* Collections are written in whatever key their source used. Each pitch is rewritten
	   with C as the resting tone, so collections of one tonality can share a staff and the
	   Key control shifts them all alike. AbcTranspose only moves up, so a resting tone that
	   sits closer to the C below is dropped an octave afterwards. */
	function toRestingToneC_s(line, info) {
		if (info.tonicPc === 0) return line;
		return line.split(/(\s+)/).map(function(token) {
			if (!/\S/.test(token)) return token;
			const moved = AbcTranspose.transpose("K:" + info.writtenKey + "\n" + token, "C").split("\n")[1];
			if (info.tonicPc > 6 || moved.charAt(0) === '"') return moved;
			return moved.replace(/([A-Ga-g])([,']*)/, function(_match, letter, marks) {
				if (marks.charAt(0) === "'") return letter + marks.slice(1);
				if (letter === letter.toLowerCase()) return letter.toUpperCase() + marks;
				return letter + marks + ",";
			});
		}).join("");
	}

	const SINGLE_NOTES_s = "1 note";

	function shiftOctaves_s(abcText, octaves) {
		if (!octaves) return abcText;
		return abcText.replace(/"[^"]*"|([A-Ga-g])([,']*)/g, function(match, letter, marks) {
			if (!letter) return match;
			let octave = (letter === letter.toLowerCase() ? 1 : 0) + octaves;
			for (let i = 0; i < marks.length; i++) octave += marks[i] === "'" ? 1 : -1;
			return octave >= 1 ? letter.toLowerCase() + "'".repeat(octave - 1) : letter.toUpperCase() + ",".repeat(-octave);
		});
	}

	/* How many staff positions the selected key moves a written pitch, as abcjs spells it. */
	const keyStepCache_s = {};
	function keySteps_s() {
		const id = getTonalKey_s() + "/" + tonalVisTranspose_s;
		if (keyStepCache_s[id] === undefined) {
			const tune = ABCJS.renderAbc("*", "X:1\nK:" + getTonalKey_s() + "\nC", { visualTranspose: tonalVisTranspose_s })[0];
			const note = tune.lines[0].staff[0].voices[0].filter(function(el) { return el.pitches; })[0];
			keyStepCache_s[id] = note.pitches[0].pitch;
		}
		return keyStepCache_s[id];
	}

	/* The seven single notes, shown as A below the staff up to G whatever the key. Each
	   carries the letter it is shown as, which is also the key that enters it. */
	function singleNoteCells_s() {
		const shift = keySteps_s();
		return ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G"].map(function(letter, i) {
			const position = i - 2 - shift;
			const pitch = shiftOctaves_s("CDEFGAB".charAt(((position % 7) + 7) % 7), Math.floor(position / 7));
			return { abc: pitch + "0", preview: pitch + "0", pitches: [pitch], letter: letter };
		});
	}

	function getTonalCells_s(name) {
		if (name === SINGLE_NOTES_s) return singleNoteCells_s();
		if (tonalCellCache_s[name]) return tonalCellCache_s[name];
		const info = collectionInfo_s(name);
		tonalCellCache_s[name] = new ABCJS.TuneBook(patternObject[name]).tunes.map(function(t) {
			const abc = toRestingToneC_s(extractV1Notes_s(t.abc, false), info);
			const preview = abc.replace(/"[^"]*"/g, "").trim();
			return { abc: abc, preview: preview, pitches: tokenizePitches_s(preview) };
		});
		return tonalCellCache_s[name];
	}

	function getTonalKey_s() {
		return collectionInfo_s(selectedCollections_s[0]).key;
	}

	function expandPitches_s(pitches, targetCount, strategy) {
		const n = pitches.length;
		if (n === targetCount) return pitches.slice();
		if (n === 0 || n > targetCount) return null;
		const base = Math.floor(targetCount / n);
		const remainder = targetCount - base * n;
		const counts = new Array(n).fill(base);
		if (strategy === "front") counts[0] += remainder;
		else if (strategy === "back") counts[n - 1] += remainder;
		else { for (let k = 0; k < remainder; k++) counts[k] += 1; }
		const result = [];
		for (let idx = 0; idx < n; idx++) {
			for (let c = 0; c < counts[idx]; c++) result.push(pitches[idx]);
		}
		return result;
	}

	function getStaffCenter_s(svg, bbox) {
		const lines = Array.from(svg.querySelectorAll("path")).map(function(p) { return p.getBBox(); })
			.filter(function(b) { return b.height < 2 && b.width > bbox.width * 0.5; });
		if (lines.length === 0) return bbox.y + bbox.height / 2;
		const top = Math.min.apply(null, lines.map(function(b) { return b.y; }));
		const bottom = Math.max.apply(null, lines.map(function(b) { return b.y + b.height; }));
		return (top + bottom) / 2;
	}

	/* ------- Shared tonality / meter sync ------- */
	let tonalVisTranspose_s = 0;

	const MINOR_MODE_s = /^(m|min|minor|aeo|aeolian|dor|dorian|phr|phrygian|loc|locrian)$/;
	function setKey_s(pitchClass) {
		document.getElementById("key-selector").value = String(pitchClass);
		tonalVisTranspose_s = pitchClass <= 6 ? pitchClass : pitchClass - 12;
	}

	function keyChanged_s() {
		setKey_s(parseInt(document.getElementById("key-selector").value, 10));
		renderTonalBank_s();
		renderAll_s();
	}

	/* Choosing a tonality selects every collection written in it. */
	function setMode_s(mode) {
		const names = allowedCollections_s.filter(function(name) { return collectionInfo_s(name).mode === mode; });
		if (names.length === 0) return false;
		const changed = selectedCollections_s.length === 0 || getTonalMode_s() !== mode;
		selectedCollections_s = names;
		document.getElementById("mode-selector").value = mode;
		syncCollectionPicker_s();
		renderTonalBank_s();
		if (changed) clearAll_s();
		return true;
	}

	function applyTonality_s() {
		if (!window.Tonality) return;
		var r = Tonality.getResting();
		if (r == null) return;
		var shared = (Tonality.getMode() || "maj").toLowerCase();
		var mode = MINOR_MODE_s.test(shared) && shared.indexOf("dor") !== 0 ? "m" : shared.slice(0, 3);
		setKey_s(r);
		if (mode === getTonalMode_s() || !setMode_s(mode)) {
			renderTonalBank_s();
			renderAll_s();
		}
	}

	function applyMeter_s() {
		var stored = null;
		try { stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("tuneMeter")); } catch(e) {}
		if (!stored) return;
		var n = stored.n, d = stored.d;
		var isTriple = (n === 3) || (n % 3 === 0 && d === 8);
		var wantFamily = isTriple ? "triple" : "duple";
		var sel = document.getElementById("rhythm-family-selector");
		if (!sel || sel.value === wantFamily) return;
		sel.value = wantFamily;
		refreshRhythmFamily_s();
	}

	/* ------- Song state ------- */
	let activeRhythmCells_s = [];
	let activeTonalCells_s = [];
	let tonalHotkeys_s = {};       /* letter -> pattern; A-G are always the single notes */
	let allowedCollections_s = [];
	let selectedCollections_s = [];
	let phrases_s = [];
	let pendingExpansionIndex_s = null;
	let fullVisualObj_s = null;
	let fullTiming_s = null;
	let activeTab_s = null;
	let noteFilter_s = null;       /* number of notes shown in the all-patterns view, or null for any */
	let chordFilter_s = null;      /* chord symbol (in C) shown in the all-patterns view, or null for any */
	let tonalOctave_s = 0;

	function changeOctave_s(step) {
		tonalOctave_s = Math.max(-2, Math.min(2, tonalOctave_s + step));
		renderTonalBank_s();
	}
	let activeSynth_s = null;
	let playTimeout_s;
	const DEFAULT_EXPANSION_STRATEGY_s = "even";
	let undoStack_s = [];
	let harmony_s = {};            /* position in macrobeats (see chordKey_s) -> chord symbol, written with C as resting tone */
	let chordCursor_s = 0;
	let melodyEndQuarters_s = 0;

	function snapshotBeforeChange_s() {
		undoStack_s.push(JSON.stringify({ phrases: phrases_s, harmony: harmony_s, cursor: chordCursor_s }));
	}

	function undo_s() {
		if (undoStack_s.length === 0) return;
		const state = JSON.parse(undoStack_s.pop());
		phrases_s = state.phrases;
		harmony_s = state.harmony;
		chordCursor_s = state.cursor;
		pendingExpansionIndex_s = null;
		renderAll_s();
	}

	function phraseHits_s(phrase) {
		return phrase.rhythmCells.reduce(function(sum, c) { return sum + c.hits; }, 0);
	}

	function phrasePitches_s(phrase) {
		return phrase.tonalCells.reduce(function(all, c) { return all.concat(c.pitches); }, []);
	}

	function isPhraseResolved_s(phrase) {
		if (phrase.rest) return true;
		if (phrase.rhythmCells.length === 0 || phrase.tonalCells.length === 0) return false;
		const hits = phraseHits_s(phrase), notes = phrasePitches_s(phrase).length;
		if (hits === notes) return true;
		return hits > notes && !!phrase.expansion;
	}

	function currentOpenPhrase_s() {
		if (phrases_s.length === 0) return null;
		const last = phrases_s[phrases_s.length - 1];
		return isPhraseResolved_s(last) ? null : last;
	}

	function openPhraseForClick_s() {
		let phrase = currentOpenPhrase_s();
		if (!phrase) {
			phrase = { rhythmCells: [], tonalCells: [], expansion: null };
			phrases_s.push(phrase);
		}
		return phrase;
	}

	/* ------- Rhythm bank ------- */
	const TIME_SIGNATURES_s = {
		duple: ["2/4", "3/4", "4/4"],
		triple: ["6/8", "9/8", "12/8", "3/4"]
	};

	function refreshTimeSignatureOptions_s() {
		const family = getActiveFamily_s();
		const selector = document.getElementById("time-signature-selector");
		selector.innerHTML = "";
		TIME_SIGNATURES_s[family].forEach(function(m) {
			const option = document.createElement("option");
			option.textContent = m;
			option.value = m;
			selector.appendChild(option);
		});
	}

	function setSelectedCriteria_s(criteria) {
		document.getElementById("crit-macrobeat").checked = criteria.macrobeat;
		document.getElementById("crit-microbeat").checked = criteria.microbeat;
		document.getElementById("crit-division").checked = criteria.division;
		document.getElementById("crit-elongation").checked = criteria.elongation;
		document.getElementById("crit-rest").checked = criteria.rest;
	}

	function criteriaChanged_s() { renderRhythmBank_s(); }

	function refreshRhythmFamily_s() {
		setSelectedCriteria_s(inferCriteriaFromCollectionName_s(getActiveFamily_s() === "triple" ? "Triple" : "Duple"));
		refreshTimeSignatureOptions_s();
		renderRhythmBank_s();
		clearAll_s();
	}

	function renderRhythmBank_s() {
		const family = getActiveFamily_s();
		const criteria = getSelectedCriteria_s();
		activeRhythmCells_s = getFilteredCells_s(family, criteria);
		const unitL = getMeterInfo_s().unitL;

		const container = document.getElementById("rhythm-cell-buttons");
		container.innerHTML = "";

		const entries = [];
		activeRhythmCells_s.forEach(function(cell, i) {
			const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
			wrapper.className = "cell-wrapper";
			const numberLabel = document.createElement("span");
			numberLabel.className = "cell-number";
			numberLabel.textContent = String(i + 1);
			wrapper.appendChild(numberLabel);

			const button = document.createElement("button");
			button.type = "button";
			button.className = "cell-btn";
			button.setAttribute("aria-label", "Rhythm cell " + (i + 1) + ": " + cell.abc);
			button.addEventListener("click", function() { appendRhythmCell_s(i); });

			const preview = document.createElement("div");
			preview.className = "cell-preview";
			button.appendChild(preview);
			wrapper.appendChild(button);
			container.appendChild(wrapper);

			const abcString = "X:1\nM:none\nL:" + unitL + "\nK:clef=none\n" + cell.abc;
			ABCJS.renderAbc(preview, abcString, { add_classes: true });

			const svg = preview.querySelector("svg");
			svg.style.transformOrigin = "0 0";
			const bbox = svg.getBBox();
			entries.push({ button: button, svg: svg, bbox: bbox });
		});

		if (entries.length === 0) return;
		const SPACING = 0.9;
		const maxScaledWidth = Math.max.apply(null, entries.map(function(e) { return e.bbox.width * SPACING; }));
		const buttonWidth = Math.ceil(maxScaledWidth) + 16;
		entries.forEach(function(entry) {
			entry.button.style.width = buttonWidth + "px";
			entry.button.style.height = "50px";
			const scaledLeft = entry.bbox.x * SPACING;
			const scaledWidth = entry.bbox.width * SPACING;
			const translateX = entry.button.clientWidth / 2 - (scaledLeft + scaledWidth / 2);
			const translateY = entry.button.clientHeight / 2 - (entry.bbox.y + entry.bbox.height / 2);
			entry.svg.style.transform = "translate(" + translateX + "px, " + translateY + "px) scale(" + SPACING + ", 1)";
		});
	}

	/* ------- Tonal bank ------- */
	function buildCollectionPicker_s() {
		const panel = document.getElementById("tonal-collection-options");
		panel.innerHTML = "";
		const groups = {};
		allowedCollections_s.forEach(function(name) {
			const mode = collectionInfo_s(name).mode;
			(groups[mode] = groups[mode] || []).push(name);
		});
		Object.keys(groups).forEach(function(mode) {
			const heading = document.createElement("div");
			heading.className = "sq-multi-heading";
			heading.textContent = TONALITY_LABELS_s[mode] || mode;
			panel.appendChild(heading);
			const list = document.createElement("div");
			list.className = "sq-multi-group";
			groups[mode].forEach(function(name) {
				const label = document.createElement("label");
				const box = document.createElement("input");
				box.type = "checkbox";
				box.value = name;
				box.addEventListener("change", function() { toggleCollection_s(name, box.checked); });
				label.appendChild(box);
				label.appendChild(document.createTextNode(name));
				list.appendChild(label);
			});
			panel.appendChild(list);
		});
	}

	function syncCollectionPicker_s() {
		document.querySelectorAll("#tonal-collection-options input").forEach(function(box) {
			box.checked = selectedCollections_s.indexOf(box.value) !== -1;
		});
		document.getElementById("tonal-collection-summary").textContent = selectedCollections_s.join(", ");
	}

	/* Collections combine within one tonality; picking another tonality starts over with it. */
	function toggleCollection_s(name, checked) {
		const previousMode = collectionInfo_s(selectedCollections_s[0]).mode;
		const mode = collectionInfo_s(name).mode;
		let next = selectedCollections_s.filter(function(n) { return n !== name && collectionInfo_s(n).mode === mode; });
		if (checked || next.length === 0) next.push(name);
		selectedCollections_s = allowedCollections_s.filter(function(n) { return next.indexOf(n) !== -1; });
		document.getElementById("mode-selector").value = mode;
		syncCollectionPicker_s();
		renderTonalBank_s();
		if (mode !== previousMode) clearAll_s();
	}

	/* Every pattern in the current tonality, single notes first, each pattern once. */
	function allTonalCells_s() {
		const mode = getTonalMode_s();
		const cells = getTonalCells_s(SINGLE_NOTES_s).slice(), seen = {};
		allowedCollections_s.forEach(function(name) {
			if (collectionInfo_s(name).mode !== mode) return;
			getTonalCells_s(name).forEach(function(cell) {
				if (seen[cell.abc] || cell.pitches.length < 2) return;
				seen[cell.abc] = true;
				cells.push(cell);
			});
		});
		return cells;
	}

	/* Patterns are tagged with their chord. Single notes belong to the chords they are tones
	   of; other untagged (stepwise) patterns join the chords they fit (see cellFitsChord_s)
	   unless that is switched off. */
	function cellInChord_s(cell, symbol) {
		const tag = /^"([^"]+)"/.exec(cell.abc);
		if (tag) return tag[1] === symbol;
		if (!getPalette_s().some(function(chord) { return chord.sym === symbol; })) return false;
		return (cell.pitches.length === 1 || document.getElementById("include-stepwise").checked) && cellFitsChord_s(cell, symbol);
	}

	function addTab_s(row, label, active, onClick) {
		const tab = document.createElement("button");
		tab.type = "button";
		tab.className = "sq-btn" + (active ? " active" : "");
		tab.textContent = label;
		tab.addEventListener("click", function() { onClick(); renderTonalBank_s(); });
		row.appendChild(tab);
	}

	function addTabRow_s(label) {
		const row = document.createElement("div");
		row.className = "cell-tabs";
		if (label) {
			const caption = document.createElement("span");
			caption.className = "sq-label";
			caption.textContent = label;
			row.appendChild(caption);
		}
		document.getElementById("tonal-tabs").appendChild(row);
		return row;
	}

	/* Draws the tabs and returns the patterns to show: one collection at a time, or every
	   pattern in the tonality narrowed by number of notes and by chord, which combine. */
	function renderTonalTabs_s() {
		const root = document.getElementById("songs-root");
		const showAll = document.getElementById("pattern-grouping").value === "all";
		document.getElementById("tonal-tabs").innerHTML = "";
		root.classList.toggle("all-patterns", showAll);
		if (!showAll) {
			root.classList.remove("by-chord");
			const names = [SINGLE_NOTES_s].concat(selectedCollections_s);
			if (names.indexOf(activeTab_s) === -1) activeTab_s = names[1] || names[0];
			const row = addTabRow_s(null);
			names.forEach(function(name) { addTab_s(row, name, name === activeTab_s, function() { activeTab_s = name; }); });
			return getTonalCells_s(activeTab_s);
		}

		const cells = allTonalCells_s();
		const counts = [], symbols = getPalette_s().map(function(chord) { return chord.sym; });
		cells.forEach(function(cell) {
			const tag = /^"([^"]+)"/.exec(cell.abc);
			if (counts.indexOf(cell.pitches.length) === -1) counts.push(cell.pitches.length);
			if (tag && symbols.indexOf(tag[1]) === -1) symbols.push(tag[1]);
		});
		counts.sort(function(a, b) { return a - b; });
		if (counts.indexOf(noteFilter_s) === -1) noteFilter_s = null;
		if (symbols.indexOf(chordFilter_s) === -1) chordFilter_s = null;
		root.classList.toggle("by-chord", chordFilter_s !== null);

		const noteRow = addTabRow_s("Notes");
		addTab_s(noteRow, "Any", noteFilter_s === null, function() { noteFilter_s = null; });
		counts.forEach(function(count) {
			addTab_s(noteRow, String(count), noteFilter_s === count, function() { noteFilter_s = count; });
		});
		const chordRow = addTabRow_s("Chord");
		addTab_s(chordRow, "Any", chordFilter_s === null, function() { chordFilter_s = null; });
		symbols.forEach(function(symbol) {
			const chord = getPalette_s().filter(function(c) { return c.sym === symbol; })[0];
			addTab_s(chordRow, chord ? chord.roman + " (" + chordLabel_s(symbol) + ")" : chordLabel_s(symbol),
				chordFilter_s === symbol, function() { chordFilter_s = symbol; });
		});

		return cells.filter(function(cell) {
			return (noteFilter_s === null || cell.pitches.length === noteFilter_s) &&
				(chordFilter_s === null || cellInChord_s(cell, chordFilter_s));
		});
	}

	function renderTonalBank_s() {
		const key = getTonalKey_s();
		const container = document.getElementById("tonal-cell-buttons");
		container.innerHTML = "";
		activeTonalCells_s = [];
		document.getElementById("octave-value").textContent = (tonalOctave_s > 0 ? "+" : "") + tonalOctave_s;

		function inOctave(written) {
			return {
				abc: shiftOctaves_s(written.abc, tonalOctave_s),
				preview: shiftOctaves_s(written.preview, tonalOctave_s),
				pitches: written.pitches.map(function(pitch) { return shiftOctaves_s(pitch, tonalOctave_s); })
			};
		}
		tonalHotkeys_s = {};
		getTonalCells_s(SINGLE_NOTES_s).forEach(function(written) { tonalHotkeys_s[written.letter] = inOctave(written); });
		let nextLetter = 7;

		const entries = [];
		[renderTonalTabs_s()].forEach(function(cells) {
			cells.forEach(function(written) {
				const cell = inOctave(written);
				const i = activeTonalCells_s.length;
				activeTonalCells_s.push(cell);
				const letter = written.letter || indexToLetter_s(nextLetter++);
				if (!written.letter) tonalHotkeys_s[letter] = cell;
				const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
				wrapper.className = "cell-wrapper";
				const numberLabel = document.createElement("span");
				numberLabel.className = "cell-number";
				numberLabel.textContent = letter;
				wrapper.appendChild(numberLabel);

				const button = document.createElement("button");
				button.type = "button";
				button.className = "cell-btn";
				button.setAttribute("aria-label", "Tonal cell " + letter + ": " + cell.preview);
				button.addEventListener("click", function() { appendTonalCell_s(i); });

				const preview = document.createElement("div");
				preview.className = "cell-preview";
				button.appendChild(preview);
				wrapper.appendChild(button);
				container.appendChild(wrapper);

				const abcString = "X:1\nM:none\n%%staffwidth 100\nK:" + key + "\n" +
					(document.getElementById("show-pattern-chords").checked ? cell.abc : cell.preview);
				ABCJS.renderAbc(preview, abcString, { add_classes: true, visualTranspose: tonalVisTranspose_s });

				const svg = preview.querySelector("svg");
				const bbox = svg.getBBox();
				const staffCenterY = getStaffCenter_s(svg, bbox);
				entries.push({ button: button, svg: svg, bbox: bbox, staffCenterY: staffCenterY });
			});
		});

		if (entries.length === 0) return;
		const marginX = Math.max.apply(null, entries.map(function(e) { return e.bbox.width; })) * 0.1;
		const halfHeight = Math.max.apply(null, entries.map(function(e) {
			return Math.max(e.staffCenterY - e.bbox.y, (e.bbox.y + e.bbox.height) - e.staffCenterY);
		}));
		const contentHeight = halfHeight * 2;
		const TONAL_SCALE = 0.7;
		const marginY = contentHeight * 0.10;
		const totalHeight = contentHeight + marginY * 2;

		entries.forEach(function(entry) {
			entry.button.style.width = (entry.bbox.width + marginX * 2) * TONAL_SCALE + "px";
			entry.button.style.height = totalHeight * TONAL_SCALE + "px";
			entry.svg.style.transformOrigin = "0 0";
			entry.svg.style.transform = "scale(" + TONAL_SCALE + ") " +
				"translate(" + (-entry.bbox.x + marginX) + "px, " + (totalHeight / 2 - entry.staffCenterY) + "px)";
		});
		applyFitDimming_s();
	}

	/* ------- Appending & pairing ------- */
	function addSplitRhythm_s(phrase, split) {
		if (split.first) { phrase.rhythmCells.push(split.first); phrase.expansion = null; }
		if (split.rest) phrases_s.push({ rhythmCells: [split.rest], tonalCells: [], expansion: null });
	}

	function addSplitTonal_s(phrase, split) {
		if (split.first) { phrase.tonalCells.push(split.first); phrase.expansion = null; }
		if (split.rest) phrases_s.push({ rhythmCells: [], tonalCells: [split.rest], expansion: null });
	}

	function appendRhythmCell_s(index) {
		const cell = activeRhythmCells_s[index];
		const hits = hitCount_s(cell.abc);
		const phrase = openPhraseForClick_s();

		const segments = tokenizeRhythmCell_s(cell.abc);
		if (segments.length > 1) {
			const meter = getMeterInfo_s();
			const offset = pickupOffsetQuarters_s(meter.Lfraction, meter.barCapacity);
			const usedSoFar = (offset + phraseRhythmQuartersSoFar_s(phrase, meter.Lfraction)) % meter.barCapacity;
			const remainingQuarters = meter.barCapacity - usedSoFar;
			if (cellQuarters_s(cell.abc, meter.Lfraction) > remainingQuarters + 1e-9) return;
		}

		snapshotBeforeChange_s();

		if (phrase.tonalCells.length > 0) {
			const remaining = phrasePitches_s(phrase).length - phraseHits_s(phrase);
			if (hits > remaining) {
				if (phrase.rhythmCells.length > 0) {
					addSplitRhythm_s(phrase, splitRhythmCellByHits_s(cell.abc, remaining));
					renderAll_s();
					return;
				}
			}
		}

		phrase.rhythmCells.push({ abc: cell.abc, hits: hits });
		phrase.expansion = null;
		renderAll_s();
	}

	function appendTonalCell_s(index) { addTonalCell_s(activeTonalCells_s[index]); }

	function addTonalCell_s(cell) {
		const phrase = openPhraseForClick_s();
		snapshotBeforeChange_s();

		const tag = /^"([^"]+)"/.exec(cell.abc);
		if (tag && document.getElementById("auto-chords").checked) {
			const meter = getMeterInfo_s();
			const at = nextPitchQuarters_s(meter);
			if (onGrid_s(at, meter.beatQuarters) && chordInEffect_s(at, meter) !== tag[1])
				harmony_s[Math.round(at / meter.beatQuarters)] = tag[1];
		}

		if (phrase.rhythmCells.length > 0) {
			const rhythmHits = phraseHits_s(phrase);
			const newTotal = phrasePitches_s(phrase).length + cell.pitches.length;

			if (newTotal > rhythmHits) {
				const remaining = rhythmHits - phrasePitches_s(phrase).length;
				addSplitTonal_s(phrase, splitTonalCellByNotes_s(cell.abc, remaining));
				renderAll_s();
				return;
			}

			if (newTotal < rhythmHits && phrase.rhythmCells.length > 1) {
				phrase.tonalCells.push({ abc: cell.abc, pitches: cell.pitches });
				const trimmed = trimRhythmCellsToHits_s(phrase.rhythmCells, newTotal);
				phrase.rhythmCells = trimmed.kept;
				phrase.expansion = null;
				if (trimmed.leftover.length) phrases_s.push({ rhythmCells: trimmed.leftover, tonalCells: [], expansion: null });
				renderAll_s();
				return;
			}
		}

		phrase.tonalCells.push({ abc: cell.abc, pitches: cell.pitches });
		phrase.expansion = null;
		renderAll_s();
	}

	/* Takes back the last pattern added to the rhythm or tonal buffer, along with the chord
	   that pattern brought with it. */
	function undoBuffer_s(side) {
		const phrase = currentOpenPhrase_s();
		if (!phrase || phrase[side].length === 0) return;
		snapshotBeforeChange_s();
		const removed = phrase[side].pop();
		phrase.expansion = null;
		const tag = side === "tonalCells" && /^"([^"]+)"/.exec(removed.abc);
		if (tag) {
			const meter = getMeterInfo_s();
			const at = nextPitchQuarters_s(meter);
			const key = Math.round(at / meter.beatQuarters);
			if (onGrid_s(at, meter.beatQuarters) && harmony_s[key] === tag[1]) delete harmony_s[key];
		}
		if (phrase.rhythmCells.length === 0 && phrase.tonalCells.length === 0) phrases_s.pop();
		renderAll_s();
	}

	function clearAll_s() {
		if (phrases_s.length > 0 || Object.keys(harmony_s).length > 0) snapshotBeforeChange_s();
		phrases_s = [];
		harmony_s = {};
		chordCursor_s = 0;
		pendingExpansionIndex_s = null;
		renderAll_s();
	}

	/* ------- Harmony ------- */
	const CHORD_PALETTES_s = {
		maj: [{ sym: "C", roman: "I", tones: [0, 4, 7] }, { sym: "F", roman: "IV", tones: [5, 9, 0] }, { sym: "G7", roman: "V7", tones: [7, 11, 2, 5] }],
		m: [{ sym: "Cm", roman: "i", tones: [0, 3, 7] }, { sym: "Fm", roman: "iv", tones: [5, 8, 0] }, { sym: "G7", roman: "V7", tones: [7, 11, 2, 5] }],
		dor: [{ sym: "Cm", roman: "i", tones: [0, 3, 7] }, { sym: "F", roman: "IV", tones: [5, 9, 0] }, { sym: "Bb", roman: "VII", tones: [10, 2, 5] }],
		mix: [{ sym: "C", roman: "I", tones: [0, 4, 7] }, { sym: "F", roman: "IV", tones: [5, 9, 0] }, { sym: "Bb", roman: "VII", tones: [10, 2, 5] }]
	};
	const MODE_FLATS_s = { maj: "", m: "BEA", dor: "BE", mix: "B" };
	const KEY_NAMES_s = ["C", "Db", "D", "Eb", "E", "F", "Gb", "G", "Ab", "A", "Bb", "B"];

	function getTonalMode_s() { return collectionInfo_s(selectedCollections_s[0]).mode; }
	function getPalette_s() { return CHORD_PALETTES_s[getTonalMode_s()] || CHORD_PALETTES_s.maj; }

	/* Chord symbols are stored in C; this is the name in the selected key. */
	function chordLabel_s(symbol) {
		const match = /^([A-G])(b?)(.*)$/.exec(symbol);
		const keyPc = parseInt(document.getElementById("key-selector").value, 10);
		return KEY_NAMES_s[(NOTE_PC_s[match[1]] + (match[2] ? 11 : 0) + keyPc) % 12] + match[3];
	}

	function tokenPc_s(token) {
		const match = /^(\^\^|\^|__|_|=)?([A-Ga-g])/.exec(token);
		if (!match) return null;
		const letter = match[2].toUpperCase();
		const accidental = match[1] === undefined
			? ((MODE_FLATS_s[getTonalMode_s()] || "").indexOf(letter) !== -1 ? -1 : 0)
			: { "=": 0, "^": 1, "^^": 2, "_": -1, "__": -2 }[match[1]];
		return (NOTE_PC_s[letter] + accidental + 12) % 12;
	}

	/* Phrases that make it into the full notation, with their pitches spread over the rhythm. */
	function fullPhrases_s() {
		const result = [];
		for (let i = 0; i < phrases_s.length; i++) {
			const phrase = phrases_s[i];
			if (phrase.rest) { result.push({ phrase: phrase, pitches: [] }); continue; }
			if (phrase.rhythmCells.length === 0 || phrase.tonalCells.length === 0) break;
			const hits = phraseHits_s(phrase);
			const pitches = phrasePitches_s(phrase);
			if (hits < pitches.length) break;
			result.push({ phrase: phrase, pitches: hits === pitches.length ? pitches
				: expandPitches_s(pitches, hits, phrase.expansion || DEFAULT_EXPANSION_STRATEGY_s) });
		}
		return result;
	}

	function melodyNotes_s(meter) {
		const notes = [];
		let now = 0;
		fullPhrases_s().forEach(function(entry) {
			let p = 0;
			entry.phrase.rhythmCells.forEach(function(rc) {
				tokenizeRhythmCell_s(rc.abc).forEach(function(seg) {
					const quarters = seg.duration * meter.Lfraction * 4;
					if (seg.type === "note") notes.push({ at: now, quarters: quarters, pc: tokenPc_s(entry.pitches[p++]) });
					now += quarters;
				});
			});
		});
		return notes;
	}

	/* Where the next tonal pattern's first pitch will sound. */
	function nextPitchQuarters_s(meter) {
		let total = resolvedPhrases_s().reduce(function(sum, ph) { return sum + phraseRhythmQuartersSoFar_s(ph, meter.Lfraction); }, 0);
		const open = currentOpenPhrase_s();
		if (!open) return total;
		let hitsLeft = phrasePitches_s(open).length;
		open.rhythmCells.forEach(function(rc) {
			tokenizeRhythmCell_s(rc.abc).forEach(function(seg) {
				if (hitsLeft <= 0 && seg.type === "note") { hitsLeft = -1; return; }
				if (hitsLeft < 0) return;
				if (seg.type === "note") hitsLeft--;
				total += seg.duration * meter.Lfraction * 4;
			});
		});
		return total;
	}

	function chordInEffect_s(quarters, meter) {
		const at = quarters / meter.beatQuarters + 1e-9;
		let latest = null;
		Object.keys(harmony_s).forEach(function(key) {
			if (Number(key) <= at && (latest === null || Number(key) > Number(latest))) latest = key;
		});
		return latest === null ? null : harmony_s[latest];
	}

	/* A pattern tagged with a chord fits that chord. An untagged one fits when it starts and
	   ends on chord tones and every pitch outside the chord is a passing or neighboring
	   tone: reached by step and left by step. */
	function cellFitsChord_s(cell, symbol) {
		const tag = /^"([^"]+)"/.exec(cell.abc);
		if (tag) return tag[1] === symbol;
		const chord = getPalette_s().filter(function(c) { return c.sym === symbol; })[0];
		if (!chord) return true;
		const pcs = cell.pitches.map(tokenPc_s).filter(function(pc) { return pc !== null; });
		if (pcs.length === 0) return true;
		function inChord(pc) { return chord.tones.indexOf(pc) !== -1; }
		function isStep(a, b) { const d = (a - b + 12) % 12; return d === 1 || d === 2 || d === 10 || d === 11; }
		return inChord(pcs[0]) && inChord(pcs[pcs.length - 1]) && pcs.every(function(pc, k) {
			return inChord(pc) || (isStep(pcs[k - 1], pc) && isStep(pc, pcs[k + 1]));
		});
	}

	function applyFitDimming_s() {
		const meter = getMeterInfo_s();
		const symbol = document.getElementById("fit-chord").checked ? chordInEffect_s(nextPitchQuarters_s(meter), meter) : null;
		document.querySelectorAll("#tonal-cell-buttons .cell-btn").forEach(function(button, i) {
			button.classList.toggle("cell-dim", !!symbol && !cellFitsChord_s(activeTonalCells_s[i], symbol));
		});
	}

	/* Rests out the rest of the current bar, or a whole bar when the song ends on a bar line. */
	function insertBlankBar_s() {
		if (currentOpenPhrase_s()) return;
		const meter = getMeterInfo_s();
		const at = phrases_s.reduce(function(sum, ph) { return sum + phraseRhythmQuartersSoFar_s(ph, meter.Lfraction); }, 0);
		const barEnd = (Math.floor(at / meter.barCapacity + 1e-9) + 1) * meter.barCapacity;
		snapshotBeforeChange_s();
		phrases_s.push({ rest: true, tonalCells: [], expansion: null,
			rhythmCells: [{ abc: "z" + fractionSuffix_s((barEnd - at) / (meter.Lfraction * 4)), hits: 0 }] });
		renderAll_s();
	}

	function setChord_s(symbol) {
		snapshotBeforeChange_s();
		if (symbol) harmony_s[chordCursor_s] = symbol;
		else delete harmony_s[chordCursor_s];
		chordCursor_s = Math.floor(chordCursor_s + 1e-9) + 1;
		renderAll_s();
	}

	function moveChordCursor_s(step) {
		chordCursor_s = step > 0 ? Math.floor(chordCursor_s + 1e-9) + 1 : Math.max(0, Math.ceil(chordCursor_s - 1e-9) - 1);
		renderFullNotation_s();
	}

	/* Fills beats that have no chord yet with the palette chord covering most of the melody there. */
	function suggestChords_s() {
		const meter = getMeterInfo_s();
		const notes = melodyNotes_s(meter).filter(function(n) { return n.pc !== null; });
		if (notes.length === 0) return;
		const palette = getPalette_s();
		const byBeat = {};
		notes.forEach(function(n) {
			const beat = Math.floor(n.at / meter.beatQuarters + 1e-9);
			(byBeat[beat] = byBeat[beat] || []).push(n);
		});
		const lastBeat = Math.max.apply(null, Object.keys(byBeat).map(Number));
		snapshotBeforeChange_s();
		for (let beat = 0; beat <= lastBeat; beat++) {
			if (harmony_s[beat] || !byBeat[beat]) continue;
			const current = chordInEffect_s(beat * meter.beatQuarters, meter);
			let best = null, bestScore = 0;
			palette.forEach(function(chord) {
				let score = 0;
				byBeat[beat].forEach(function(n, i) {
					if (chord.tones.indexOf(n.pc) !== -1) score += n.quarters * (i === 0 ? 2 : 1);
				});
				if (score > bestScore + 1e-9) { best = chord.sym; bestScore = score; }
			});
			if (beat === lastBeat && notes[notes.length - 1].pc === 0) best = palette[0].sym;
			if (best && best !== current) harmony_s[beat] = best;
		}
		renderAll_s();
	}

	function renderChordControls_s() {
		const paletteBox = document.getElementById("chord-palette");
		paletteBox.innerHTML = "";
		getPalette_s().concat([{ sym: null }]).forEach(function(chord) {
			const button = document.createElement("button");
			button.type = "button";
			button.className = "sq-btn";
			button.textContent = chord.sym ? chord.roman + " (" + chordLabel_s(chord.sym) + ")" : "No chord";
			button.addEventListener("click", function() { setChord_s(chord.sym); });
			paletteBox.appendChild(button);
		});
	}

	/* ------- Rendering ------- */
	/* Lays notation out to the paper's own width, wrapping at bar lines, then gives the
	   SVG a viewBox so it keeps fitting if the paper is resized. */
	function renderPaper_s(paperId, abcString, clickListener) {
		const paper = document.getElementById(paperId);
		const visualObj = ABCJS.renderAbc(paper, abcString, {
			add_classes: true,
			clickListener: clickListener,
			visualTranspose: tonalVisTranspose_s,
			staffwidth: Math.max(paper.clientWidth - 46, 200),
			wrap: { minSpacing: 1.8, maxSpacing: 2.7, preferredMeasuresPerLine: 4 }
		})[0];
		const svg = paper.querySelector("svg");
		if (svg) svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 " + svg.getAttribute("width") + " " + svg.getAttribute("height"));
		return visualObj;
	}

	function syncStickyOffset_s() {
		const root = document.getElementById("songs-root");
		const header = document.getElementById("quarto-header");
		const sessionBar = document.getElementById("session-nav-bar");
		if (header) root.style.setProperty("--nav-h", header.offsetHeight + "px");
		if (sessionBar) root.style.setProperty("--session-h", sessionBar.offsetHeight + "px");
	}

	function joinCells_s(cells) {
		if (cells.length === 0) return "";
		return cells.map(function(c) { return c.abc; }).join(" || ") + " ||";
	}

	function renderCuedFields_s() {
		const phrase = currentOpenPhrase_s();
		const rhythmCells = phrase ? phrase.rhythmCells : [];
		const tonalCells = phrase ? phrase.tonalCells : [];

		const meter = getMeterInfo_s();
		const rhythmHeader = "X:1\nM:" + meter.timeSignature + "\nL:" + meter.unitL + "\nK:clef=none\n";
		const rhythmOffset = pickupOffsetQuarters_s(meter.Lfraction, meter.barCapacity);
		const rhythmBody = renderBarredWords_s(rhythmCells, null, rhythmOffset, meter, null).join(" ");
		document.getElementById("cued-rhythm").value = rhythmBody ? rhythmHeader + rhythmBody : "";
		document.getElementById("cued-rhythm-paper").classList.toggle("is-empty", rhythmCells.length === 0);
		renderPaper_s("cued-rhythm-paper", rhythmHeader + rhythmBody);

		const tonalKey = getTonalKey_s();
		const tonalHeader = "X:1\nM:none\nK:" + tonalKey + "\n";
		const showChords = document.getElementById("show-pattern-chords").checked;
		const tonalBody = showChords ? joinCells_s(tonalCells) : joinCells_s(tonalCells).replace(/"[^"]*"/g, "");
		document.getElementById("cued-tonal").value = tonalBody ? tonalHeader + tonalBody : "";
		document.getElementById("cued-tonal-paper").classList.toggle("is-empty", tonalCells.length === 0);
		renderPaper_s("cued-tonal-paper", tonalHeader + tonalBody);

		let rhythmNote = "", tonalNote = "";
		if (rhythmCells.length > 0 && tonalCells.length > 0) {
			const hits = phraseHits_s(phrase), notes = phrasePitches_s(phrase).length;
			if (hits < notes) {
				rhythmNote = "Needs " + (notes - hits) + " more note" + ((notes - hits) === 1 ? "" : "s") +
					" to match the tonal pattern — pick more rhythm.";
			} else if (hits > notes) {
				tonalNote = "Needs " + (hits - notes) + " more note" + ((hits - notes) === 1 ? "" : "s") +
					" to match the rhythm — pick more tonal patterns, or choose an expansion below.";
			}
		}
		document.getElementById("undo-rhythm").disabled = rhythmCells.length === 0;
		document.getElementById("undo-tonal").disabled = tonalCells.length === 0;
		document.getElementById("cued-rhythm-note").textContent = rhythmNote;
		document.getElementById("cued-tonal-note").textContent = tonalNote;
	}

	function renderPhraseRhythmWords_s(rhythmCells, pitches) {
		let p = 0;
		return rhythmCells.map(function(rc) {
			return tokenizeRhythmCell_s(rc.abc).map(function(seg) {
				if (seg.type === "note") return pitches[p++] + seg.suffix + seg.tie + seg.dotMark;
				return "z" + seg.suffix + seg.tie + seg.dotMark;
			}).join("");
		});
	}

	function renderExpansionPicker_s() {
		const picker = document.getElementById("expansion-picker");
		pendingExpansionIndex_s = null;
		for (let i = 0; i < phrases_s.length; i++) {
			const phrase = phrases_s[i];
			const hits = phraseHits_s(phrase), notes = phrasePitches_s(phrase).length;
			if (phrase.rhythmCells.length && phrase.tonalCells.length && hits > notes && !phrase.expansion) {
				pendingExpansionIndex_s = i;
				break;
			}
		}
		if (pendingExpansionIndex_s === null) {
			picker.classList.remove("visible");
			return;
		}
		picker.classList.add("visible");
		const index = pendingExpansionIndex_s;
		const phrase = phrases_s[index];
		const hits = phraseHits_s(phrase);
		const pitches = phrasePitches_s(phrase);
		document.getElementById("expansion-explainer").textContent =
			"Phrase " + (index + 1) + ": fitting " + pitches.length + " pitches into " + hits +
			" notes. Full notation is already previewing \"Spread evenly\" — press X, Y, or Z for a different one, or keep clicking tonal patterns.";

		const strategies = [["X", "front", "Repeat first"], ["Y", "even", "Spread evenly"], ["Z", "back", "Repeat last"]];
		const optionsContainer = document.getElementById("expansion-options");
		optionsContainer.innerHTML = "";
		const tonalKey = getTonalKey_s();
		strategies.forEach(function(s) {
			const key = s[0], strategy = s[1], label = s[2];
			const expanded = expandPitches_s(pitches, hits, strategy);
			const combined = renderPhraseRhythmWords_s(phrase.rhythmCells, expanded).join(" ");

			const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
			wrapper.className = "expansion-option";
			const keyLabel = document.createElement("div");
			keyLabel.className = "expansion-key";
			keyLabel.textContent = key + " — " + label + (strategy === DEFAULT_EXPANSION_STRATEGY_s ? " (default)" : "");
			wrapper.appendChild(keyLabel);

			const preview = document.createElement("div");
			preview.style.width = "140px";
			preview.style.height = "60px";
			wrapper.appendChild(preview);

			const button = document.createElement("button");
			button.type = "button";
			button.className = "sq-btn";
			button.textContent = "Choose " + key;
			button.addEventListener("click", function() { resolveExpansion_s(index, strategy); });
			wrapper.appendChild(button);

			optionsContainer.appendChild(wrapper);
			ABCJS.renderAbc(preview, "X:1\nM:none\n%%staffwidth 80\nK:" + tonalKey + "\n" + combined, { add_classes: true, visualTranspose: tonalVisTranspose_s });
		});
	}

	function resolveExpansion_s(index, strategy) {
		snapshotBeforeChange_s();
		phrases_s[index].expansion = strategy;
		renderAll_s();
	}

	function renderFullNotation_s() {
		const tonalKey = getTonalKey_s();
		const meter = getMeterInfo_s();
		const { Lfraction, timeSignature, barCapacity, unitL, beatQuarters } = meter;

		/* the whole song is spelled in one go, so beams and rests join across phrases */
		const cells = [], pitches = [];
		let total = 0;
		fullPhrases_s().forEach(function(entry) {
			cells.push.apply(cells, entry.phrase.rhythmCells);
			pitches.push.apply(pitches, entry.pitches);
			total += phraseRhythmQuartersSoFar_s(entry.phrase, Lfraction);
		});
		melodyEndQuarters_s = total;

		/* chords (and the chord cursor) ahead of the melody sit over rests until the melody reaches them */
		const lastChord = Math.max.apply(null, [chordCursor_s].concat(Object.keys(harmony_s).map(Number)));
		if (lastChord * beatQuarters >= total - 1e-9) {
			const fillEnd = (Math.floor(lastChord * beatQuarters / barCapacity + 1e-9) + 1) * barCapacity;
			cells.push({ abc: "z" + fractionSuffix_s((fillEnd - total) / (Lfraction * 4)) });
		}
		const outputWords = renderBarredWords_s(cells, pitches, 0, meter, harmony_s);

		const body = outputWords.join(" ");
		const abcString = "X:1\n%%MIDI program 4 \nM:" + timeSignature + "\nL:" + unitL +
			"\nQ:" + tempoField_s(meter) + "\nK:" + tonalKey + "\n" + body;
		document.getElementById("full-notation").value = body ? abcString : "";
		renderFullPaper_s(body ? abcString : "X:1\nM:" + timeSignature + "\nK:" + tonalKey + "\n");
		const paper = document.getElementById("full-paper");
		paper.scrollTop = paper.scrollHeight;
	}

	function renderFullPaper_s(abcString) {
		stopPlayback_s();
		fullVisualObj_s = renderPaper_s("full-paper", abcString, staffClicked_s);
		fullTiming_s = new ABCJS.TimingCallbacks(fullVisualObj_s, { eventCallback: showPlayingNote_s });
		markChordCursor_s();
	}

	function markElements_s(className, event) {
		document.querySelectorAll("#full-paper ." + className).forEach(function(el) { el.classList.remove(className); });
		((event && event.elements) || []).forEach(function(group) {
			group.forEach(function(el) { el.classList.add(className); });
		});
	}

	function showPlayingNote_s(event) { markElements_s("sq-playing", event); }

	function timedEvents_s() {
		return fullTiming_s ? fullTiming_s.noteTimings.filter(function(t) { return t.type === "event"; }) : [];
	}

	function eventBeat_s(event) {
		return chordKey_s(event.milliseconds / (60000 / getTempo_s()));
	}

	/* The chord cursor shows as the tinted note or rest on the staff. Clicking a note or rest
	   moves it there, so the next chord picked changes over that note, on the beat or not. */
	function markChordCursor_s() {
		let current = null;
		timedEvents_s().forEach(function(event) { if (eventBeat_s(event) <= chordCursor_s + 1e-6) current = event; });
		markElements_s("sq-cursor", current);
		const meter = getMeterInfo_s();
		const beatsPerBar = Math.round(meter.barCapacity / meter.beatQuarters);
		document.getElementById("chord-position").textContent =
			"Bar " + (Math.floor(chordCursor_s / beatsPerBar + 1e-9) + 1) +
			(beatsPerBar > 1 ? ", beat " + (Math.floor(chordCursor_s + 1e-9) % beatsPerBar + 1) : "") +
			(onGrid_s(chordCursor_s, 1) ? "" : ", selected note");
	}

	function staffClicked_s(abcElem) {
		const event = timedEvents_s().filter(function(t) { return (t.startCharArray || []).indexOf(abcElem.startChar) !== -1; })[0];
		if (!event) return;
		chordCursor_s = eventBeat_s(event);
		markChordCursor_s();
	}

	function stopPlayback_s() {
		clearTimeout(playTimeout_s);
		if (fullTiming_s) fullTiming_s.stop();
		showPlayingNote_s(null);
		if (activeSynth_s) { activeSynth_s.stop(); activeSynth_s = null; }
		document.getElementById("play-button").textContent = "\u25B6 Play";
	}

	function togglePlayback_s() {
		if (activeSynth_s) { stopPlayback_s(); return; }
		if (!fullVisualObj_s || !ABCJS.synth.supportsAudio()) return;
		const audioContext = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
		const synth = new ABCJS.synth.CreateSynth();
		activeSynth_s = synth;
		document.getElementById("play-button").textContent = "\u25A0 Stop";
		getSoundfontUrl().then(function(sfUrl) {
			return synth.init({
				audioContext: audioContext,
				visualObj: fullVisualObj_s,
				options: { soundFontUrl: sfUrl, chordsOff: !document.getElementById("play-chords-s").checked }
			});
		}).then(function() { return synth.prime(); }).then(function(result) {
			if (activeSynth_s !== synth) return;
			synth.start();
			fullTiming_s.start();
			playTimeout_s = setTimeout(stopPlayback_s, result.duration * 1000 + 300);
		}).catch(function(error) { console.warn("Audio problem:", error); stopPlayback_s(); });
	}

	function renderAll_s() {
		renderCuedFields_s();
		renderExpansionPicker_s();
		renderFullNotation_s();
		renderChordControls_s();
		applyFitDimming_s();
	}

	let editTimeout_s;
	function editFullNotation_s() {
		clearTimeout(editTimeout_s);
		editTimeout_s = setTimeout(function() {
			renderFullPaper_s(document.getElementById("full-notation").value);
		}, 400);
	}

	/* The settings panel hangs from the right edge of its button, shifted as needed to stay on screen. */
	function placeSettingsPanel_s() {
		const details = document.querySelector("#songs-root .sq-settings");
		if (!details.open) return;
		const panel = details.querySelector(".sq-multi-panel");
		const anchor = details.getBoundingClientRect();
		const width = panel.offsetWidth, viewport = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
		const left = Math.max(8, Math.min(anchor.right - width, viewport - width - 8));
		panel.style.right = "auto";
		panel.style.left = (left - anchor.left) + "px";
	}

	function load_s() {
		const S_CFG = window.TOOL_CONFIG || {};
		const configured = (S_CFG.tonalCollections || []).filter(function(name) { return patternObject[name]; });
		allowedCollections_s = Object.keys(patternObject).filter(function(name) {
			return configured.length === 0 || configured.indexOf(name) !== -1;
		});
		const modeSelector = document.getElementById("mode-selector");
		allowedCollections_s.forEach(function(name) {
			const mode = collectionInfo_s(name).mode;
			if (modeSelector.querySelector('option[value="' + mode + '"]')) return;
			const option = document.createElement("option");
			option.value = mode;
			option.textContent = TONALITY_LABELS_s[mode] || mode;
			modeSelector.appendChild(option);
		});
		selectedCollections_s = allowedCollections_s.filter(function(name) {
			return collectionInfo_s(name).mode === collectionInfo_s(allowedCollections_s[0]).mode;
		});
		buildCollectionPicker_s();
		syncCollectionPicker_s();
		if (modeSelector.options.length <= 1) modeSelector.closest('.sq-group').style.display = 'none';
		setKey_s(collectionInfo_s(selectedCollections_s[0]).tonicPc);
		const tonalPicker = document.getElementById("tonal-collection-picker");
		if (S_CFG.lockTonalCollections || allowedCollections_s.length <= 1)
			tonalPicker.closest('.sq-group').style.display = 'none';
		document.addEventListener("click", function(e) {
			document.querySelectorAll("#songs-root .sq-multi[open]").forEach(function(d) { if (!d.contains(e.target)) d.open = false; });
		});
		if (S_CFG.rhythmFamily) document.getElementById('rhythm-family-selector').value = S_CFG.rhythmFamily;
		if (S_CFG.lockRhythmFamily)
			(document.getElementById('rhythm-family-selector').closest('.sq-group') || document.getElementById('rhythm-family-selector')).style.display = 'none';
		if (S_CFG.lockTimeSignature)
			(document.getElementById('time-signature-selector').closest('.sq-group') || document.getElementById('time-signature-selector')).style.display = 'none';
		if (S_CFG.chords === false) document.getElementById('chord-bar').style.display = 'none';
		if (S_CFG.lockCriteria)
			document.querySelectorAll('#songs-root .cell-criteria input[type=checkbox]').forEach(function(cb) { cb.disabled = true; });


		syncStickyOffset_s();
		window.addEventListener("load", syncStickyOffset_s);
		window.addEventListener("resize", syncStickyOffset_s);
		document.querySelector("#songs-root .sq-settings").addEventListener("toggle", placeSettingsPanel_s);
		window.addEventListener("resize", placeSettingsPanel_s);

		refreshRhythmFamily_s();
		renderTonalBank_s();
		renderAll_s();

		if (window.Tonality) {
			Tonality.onChange(function(st, src) { if (src !== "local") applyTonality_s(); });
			applyTonality_s();
		}
		applyMeter_s();
		window.addEventListener("storage", function(e) { if (e.key === "tuneMeter") applyMeter_s(); });

		document.addEventListener("keydown", function(e) {
			const active = document.activeElement;
			const isTyping = active && (active.tagName === "TEXTAREA" || (active.tagName === "INPUT" && active.type !== "checkbox" && active.type !== "radio"));
			if (isTyping) return;
			if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;

			const key = e.key.toUpperCase();

			if (key === "U") { undo_s(); return; }

			if (pendingExpansionIndex_s !== null) {
				if (key === "X") { resolveExpansion_s(pendingExpansionIndex_s, "front"); return; }
				if (key === "Y") { resolveExpansion_s(pendingExpansionIndex_s, "even"); return; }
				if (key === "Z") { resolveExpansion_s(pendingExpansionIndex_s, "back"); return; }
			}

			const number = parseInt(e.key, 10);
			if (!isNaN(number) && number >= 1 && number <= activeRhythmCells_s.length) {
				appendRhythmCell_s(number - 1);
				return;
			}

			if (e.key.length === 1 && tonalHotkeys_s[key]) addTonalCell_s(tonalHotkeys_s[key]);
		});
	}
</script>

<div id="songs-root">

	<!-- Full notation (output) -->
	<div class="sq-card sq-sticky">
		<div id="full-paper" class="sq-paper"></div>
		<textarea id="full-notation" spellcheck="false" oninput="editFullNotation_s()"></textarea>
		<div class="expansion-picker" id="expansion-picker">
			<p id="expansion-explainer"></p>
			<div class="expansion-options" id="expansion-options"></div>
		</div>
		<div class="sq-row">
			<button type="button" class="sq-btn" id="play-button" onclick="togglePlayback_s()">&#9654; Play</button>
			<button type="button" class="sq-btn" onclick="undo_s()">Undo (u)</button>
			<button type="button" class="sq-btn" onclick="insertBlankBar_s()">+ Blank bar</button>
			<div class="sq-row" id="chord-bar">
				<button type="button" class="sq-btn" onclick="moveChordCursor_s(-1)" aria-label="Previous beat">&#9666;</button>
				<span class="chord-position" id="chord-position"></span>
				<button type="button" class="sq-btn" onclick="moveChordCursor_s(1)" aria-label="Next beat">&#9656;</button>
				<div class="chord-palette" id="chord-palette"></div>
				<button type="button" class="sq-btn" onclick="suggestChords_s()">Suggest chords</button>
			</div>
			<details class="sq-multi sq-settings">
				<summary>Settings</summary>
				<div class="sq-multi-panel">
					<div class="sq-group">
						<span class="sq-label">Tonality</span>
						<select id="mode-selector" onchange="setMode_s(this.value)"></select>
					</div>
					<div class="sq-group">
						<span class="sq-label">Key</span>
						<select id="key-selector" onchange="keyChanged_s()">
							<option value="0">C</option><option value="1">Db</option><option value="2">D</option>
							<option value="3">Eb</option><option value="4">E</option><option value="5">F</option>
							<option value="6">Gb</option><option value="7">G</option><option value="8">Ab</option>
							<option value="9">A</option><option value="10">Bb</option><option value="11">B</option>
						</select>
					</div>
						<div class="sq-group">
							<span class="sq-label">Meter</span>
							<select id="rhythm-family-selector" onchange="refreshRhythmFamily_s()">
								<option value="duple">Duple</option>
								<option value="triple">Triple</option>
							</select>
						</div>
						<div class="sq-group">
							<span class="sq-label">Time signature</span>
							<select id="time-signature-selector" onchange="renderRhythmBank_s(); renderAll_s();"></select>
						</div>
					<div class="sq-group">
						<span class="sq-label">Tempo</span>
						<input type="number" id="tempo-input" min="30" max="240" value="90" title="Macrobeats per minute" onchange="tempoChanged_s()">
					</div>
					<button type="button" class="sq-btn" onclick="clearAll_s()">Clear All</button>
					<label class="sq-check"><input type="checkbox" id="fit-chord" checked onchange="applyFitDimming_s()"> Dim patterns that don't fit the chord</label>
					<label class="sq-check"><input type="checkbox" id="auto-chords" checked> Add chords from patterns</label>
					<label class="sq-check"><input type="checkbox" id="play-chords-s" checked onchange="stopPlayback_s()"> Play chords</label>
					<label class="sq-check"><input type="checkbox" onchange="document.getElementById('songs-root').classList.toggle('show-abc', this.checked)"> Show ABC</label>
				</div>
			</details>
		</div>
	</div>

	<div class="sq-cols">

		<!-- Rhythm input -->
		<div class="sq-card">
			<h2>Rhythm</h2>
			<div class="cell-bank">
				<div class="cell-buttons" id="rhythm-cell-buttons"></div>
			</div>
			<div id="cued-rhythm-paper" class="sq-paper"></div>
			<textarea id="cued-rhythm" spellcheck="false" readonly></textarea>
			<div class="cue-note" id="cued-rhythm-note"></div>
			<div class="sq-row" style="margin-bottom:.6rem">
				<button type="button" class="sq-btn" id="undo-rhythm" onclick="undoBuffer_s('rhythmCells')" aria-label="Undo last rhythm pattern">Undo</button>
				<div class="cell-criteria">
					<label><input type="checkbox" id="crit-macrobeat" onchange="criteriaChanged_s()"> Macrobeat</label>
					<label><input type="checkbox" id="crit-microbeat" onchange="criteriaChanged_s()"> Microbeat</label>
					<label><input type="checkbox" id="crit-division" onchange="criteriaChanged_s()"> Division</label>
					<label><input type="checkbox" id="crit-elongation" onchange="criteriaChanged_s()"> Elongation</label>
					<label><input type="checkbox" id="crit-rest" onchange="criteriaChanged_s()"> Rest</label>
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>

		<!-- Tonal input -->
		<div class="sq-card">
			<h2>Tonal</h2>
			<div id="tonal-tabs"></div>
			<div class="cell-bank">
				<div class="cell-buttons" id="tonal-cell-buttons"></div>
			</div>
			<div id="cued-tonal-paper" class="sq-paper"></div>
			<textarea id="cued-tonal" spellcheck="false" readonly></textarea>
			<div class="cue-note" id="cued-tonal-note"></div>
			<div class="sq-row" style="margin-bottom:.6rem">
				<button type="button" class="sq-btn" id="undo-tonal" onclick="undoBuffer_s('tonalCells')" aria-label="Undo last tonal pattern">Undo</button>
				<div class="sq-group">
					<span class="sq-label">Collections</span>
					<details class="sq-multi" id="tonal-collection-picker">
						<summary id="tonal-collection-summary"></summary>
						<div class="sq-multi-panel">
							<p class="sq-multi-hint">Collections in the same tonality can be combined.</p>
							<div id="tonal-collection-options"></div>
						</div>
					</details>
				</div>
				<div class="sq-group">
					<span class="sq-label">Show</span>
					<select id="pattern-grouping" onchange="renderTonalBank_s()">
						<option value="collection">Selected collections</option>
						<option value="all">All patterns</option>
					</select>
				</div>
				<div class="sq-group">
					<span class="sq-label">Octave</span>
					<div class="sq-row">
						<button type="button" class="sq-btn" onclick="changeOctave_s(-1)" aria-label="Octave down">&minus;</button>
						<span class="chord-position" id="octave-value">0</span>
						<button type="button" class="sq-btn" onclick="changeOctave_s(1)" aria-label="Octave up">+</button>
					</div>
				</div>
				<label class="sq-check"><input type="checkbox" id="show-pattern-chords" onchange="renderTonalBank_s(); renderCuedFields_s()"> Show chords</label>
				<label class="sq-check" id="include-stepwise-label"><input type="checkbox" id="include-stepwise" checked onchange="renderTonalBank_s()"> Include stepwise patterns (passing and neighboring tones)</label>
			</div>
		</div>

	</div>

</div>
```
